title: Three Months and One Short Chart
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：lifestyle　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lifestyle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1995 the doctor ① changed the lifestyle that no patient in the clinic would have recorded, and he said the changing was the whole of the month. The ② lifestyle, meaning the routine itself and not the chart, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lifestyle, he said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lifestyle in that clinic had the same short chart beside it, and the ④ lifestyle at the far desk, meaning the rule they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lifestyle, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the doctor said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lifestyle was the whole of the matter, meaning the health and not the routine. The ⑥ lifestyle, meaning the health and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lifestyle, he said, is either something you change or the only word that means both a routine and a health. He said the health is the part they remember.

By 2000 the ⑦ lifestyle had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short chart. The ⑧ lifestyle of the whole thing, the doctor wrote in January, was one clinic and three months of recording; lifestyle, he said, is either the rule at the far desk or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lifestyle I remember is the routine recorded in the record, which closed in 2002 and is still recorded as the quietest in the clinic. A ⑩ lifestyle, my mother said in 2004, is the only routine that improves by being recorded; every lifestyle, she said, is a health that has agreed to look like a routine. She said the health was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 生活方式；作息（指卫生所里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 生活方式；作息（指那种生活方式本身，与图表相对）
C. 固定搭配：change the lifestyle 改变这种生活方式
D. n. 生活方式；作息（指留给孩子们照着做的那一条那一种）
E. n. 起居之事（抽象总称，指一处卫生所的生活方式之事）
F. n. 生活方式；作息（指健康档案里写到、被记载的的那一种）
G. n. 健康、讲究（指一件事里人人都过却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 讲究（抽象总称，指人人都过却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: changed the lifestyle that no patient in the clinic would have recorded

the lifestyle at the far desk

answers.why: change the lifestyle 意为“改变这种生活方式”，1995 年那位大夫把卫生所里没有一位病人肯记载的一种生活方式做了一遍。
lifestyle 意为“生活方式；作息”，指那种生活方式本身而不是图表，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
lifestyle 意为“生活方式；作息”，指卫生所里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一张薄薄的图表。
lifestyle 意为“生活方式；作息”，指最远那张桌边留给孩子们照着做的那一条那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lifestyle 意为“健康、讲究”，指一件事里人人都过却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份讲究就是那件事的全部。
lifestyle 意为“讲究”，指人人都过却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种生活方式，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lifestyle 意为“生活方式；作息”，指健康档案里写到、被记载的的那一种，到 2000 年这一种成了健康档案里的一行。
lifestyle 意为“起居之事”，大夫一月写道，整件事的生活方式之事是一处卫生所和三个月份的记载。
lifestyle 意为“生活方式；作息”，我记得的是健康档案里记载过的那一种，2002 年定下了，至今仍被说成卫生所里最安静的一种。
lifestyle 为抽象总称，母亲 2004 年说，生活方式是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的生活方式。
